financials_interim.notes: Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30.06.2026), same filing (p.5,7,9), COMPANY (standalone holding-company) basis. Company has no cost of sales (gross_profit=revenue, a pure holding/management company); operating_profit = 'Profit from operating activities' (8,174,624). Company PBT fell 83% YoY (17,808,001 to 2,948,860) and PAT fell 94% (15,417,736 to 972,750) despite Group-level PBT/PAT both growing strongly -- the Company (parent-only) result is dominated by 'Other Income' (up 104% to 4,767,498, but off a small base) and a swing in Net Finance Income/(Cost) from -2,107,185 to -5,225,764 (finance cost roughly flat but finance income fell 64% to 1,726,545 from 4,834,585), i.e. the parent earned much less on its own cash/investments this quarter than a year earlier, unrelated to the e-commerce operating business consolidated only at Group level. Identity check ties: PBT-tax=PAT (2,948,860-1,976,110=972,750); total_assets=total_liab+total_equity (1,600,921,947=322,904,738+1,278,017,209). cash_and_equivalents = balance-sheet line (7,114,972), net of Rs.47,247 overdraft per Note 11 = 7,067,725 (matches cash flow closing balance). short_term_borrowings = current Interest Bearing Loans and Borrowings (46,249,004) + Bank Overdraft (47,247) = 46,296,251. long_term_borrowings = non-current Interest Bearing Loans and Borrowings (88,415,883). capex = Acquisition of PPE (1,833,184).

Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30.06.2026), p.5 balance sheet, p.6 income statement, p.9 cash flow. GROUP basis. Figures in the filing are in whole Rs (not Rs'000), hence unit_scale='1'. operating_profit = 'Profit/(Loss) from operating activities' (5,071,019), which already nets 'Other Income and Gains' (19,779,228); this is the filing's own subtotal before Finance Cost/Income. Identity checks tie exactly: PBT-tax=PAT (24,906,293-5,724,038=19,182,255); total_assets=total_liab+total_equity (1,461,949,219=605,702,764+856,246,455, where total_liabilities=Non-Current Liab 268,907,762 + Current Liab 336,795,002). DATA-QUALITY FLAG: the filing's own EPS note (8.6, p.12-13) computes 'Earning/(deficit) per share' by dividing 'Net profit/(loss) for the period' -- but the figure it plugs in for Group 2026 is 16,852,790, which is actually TOTAL COMPREHENSIVE INCOME (profit 19,182,255 plus OCI of -2,329,465 FX translation loss), not the profit-for-the-period figure (19,182,255) shown two lines above it in the same note and in the P&L itself. 16,852,790/164,130,360=0.1027, rounding to the printed 0.10 -- confirming this is how the filing derived its own headline EPS. The correctly-computed PAT-based EPS would be 19,182,255/164,130,360=0.1168 (~0.12). eps_basic is stored here as the filing's own printed/disclosed figure (0.10) for consistency with the source document, with this discrepancy flagged for the record. (For Company basis this quirk is invisible because Company had zero OCI, so PAT and TCI coincide.) cash_and_equivalents = balance-sheet 'Cash & Cash Equivalents' line (128,751,028); Note 11 shows this net of a Rs.515,627 bank overdraft = 128,235,401, which is what the cash flow statement's own 'Cash and Cash Equivalents at the end of the quarter' reconciles to. short_term_borrowings = current 'Interest Bearing Loans and Borrowings' (101,273,282) + Bank Overdraft (515,627) = 101,788,909 (combined, as there is no separate dedicated 'short-term borrowings' line distinct from these two). long_term_borrowings = non-current 'Interest Bearing Loans and Borrowings' (117,750,546) only. capex = 'Acquisition of Property, Plant and Equipment' (48,127,845), stored as a negative outflow; note the Group also had a large PPE disposal (sale proceeds 90,819,131) this quarter, which is why 'Net Cash Flows from Investing Activities' is a large net INFLOW (85,073,761) despite the capex outflow. shares_in_issue = 164,130,360 (Note 8.4, unchanged during the period).

_gaps: ebitda: depreciation_amortization not disclosed; EBITDA understated (= operating profit only)
